import copy
import unittest

from solution import GridReducer


class GridReducerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_maximum_adaptive_bins_and_traversal_order(self):
        reducer = GridReducer("maximum", [(1, 2), (3, 1)])
        batch = [[[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]], [[-1]]]
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(batch)
        result = reducer.reduce(batch)
        self.assertEqual(result[0], [4, 6, 0.0, 3, 6])
        self.assertEqual(result[1], [-1, 0.0, -1, 0.0, -1])
        self.assertEqual(batch, snapshot)
        self.assertIsNot(result, batch)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], batch[0])

    def test_mean_uses_only_included_cells(self):
        reducer = GridReducer("mean", [(1, 2), (3, 1)])
        batch = [[[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]]
        mask = [[[True, False, True], [False, True, False]]]
        batch_snapshot = copy.deepcopy(batch)
        mask_snapshot = copy.deepcopy(mask)
        self.assertEqual(reducer.reduce(batch, mask), [[1.0, 4.0, 0.0, 2.0, 5.0]])
        self.assertEqual(batch, batch_snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(mask, mask_snapshot)

    def test_fully_masked_and_empty_geometric_bins(self):
        reducer = GridReducer("maximum", [(2, 2)])
        batch = [[[7]]]
        mask = [[[False]]]
        self.assertEqual(reducer.reduce(batch, mask), [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]])

    def test_empty_batch_contract(self):
        reducer = GridReducer("mean", [(1, 1)])
        self.assertEqual(reducer.reduce([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(reducer.reduce([], []), [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            reducer.reduce([], [[]])

    def test_invalid_constructor_arguments(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            GridReducer(1, [(1, 1)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            GridReducer("minimum", [(1, 1)])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            GridReducer("maximum", (1, 1))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            GridReducer("maximum", [])
        invalid_levels = [[1, 1], (1,), (1, 1, 1), (True, 1), (1, False), (1.5, 1)]
        for level in invalid_levels:
            with self.subTest(level=level), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                GridReducer("maximum", [level])
        for level in ((0, 1), (1, 0), (-1, 2)):
            with self.subTest(level=level), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                GridReducer("maximum", [level])

    def test_invalid_batch_shapes_and_cells(self):
        reducer = GridReducer("maximum", [(1, 1)])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            reducer.reduce(([[1]],))
        for batch in ([[]], [[[]]], [[[1, 2], [3]]]):
            with self.subTest(batch=batch), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                reducer.reduce(batch)
        for value in (True, False, "1", None):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                reducer.reduce([[[value]]])

    def test_invalid_masks(self):
        reducer = GridReducer("mean", [(1, 1)])
        batch = [[[1, 2], [3, 4]]]
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            reducer.reduce(batch, "mask")
        for mask in ([], [None], [[[True, True]]], [[[True], [True]]]):
            with self.subTest(mask=mask), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                reducer.reduce(batch, mask)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            reducer.reduce(batch, [[[True, True], [True, 1]]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
